text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the All Comers. Nice Nature and 
the others successfully took over the 
broadcasting booth at Tokai Teio's 
"Farewell Live."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now it's up to Twin Turbo. What does it 
truly mean to "never give up"? It's time 
to show that to her rival!
